examples.input: repeat `config set agent "{temp: 0.5, model: sonnet, beta: 3}"`, then `config history`

results.1: All arms: exit 0; the file is unchanged and no new events are added (the history still ends at seq 14).
results.2: All arms: exit 0; the file is unchanged and no new events are added (still ends at seq 14).
results.3: exit 0; the file is unchanged and no new events are added (still ends at seq 14).

context.in_practice: All routes record the same events: one per changed, added or removed leaf, and nothing for a set that changes nothing. Only the order differs. Routes 1 and 2 list new values first, then removals. Route 3 lists removals first. On routes 1 and 2 the order of the new values follows the file, and the arms wrote the keys in different orders (one keeps the old `model` position, one uses the typed order), so the history order differs between arms. List elements are tracked by position on every route: shrinking `[grep, sed, awk]` to `[sed]` is logged as "sed removed from tools.1", even though sed stays in the list.
context.stakes: Every `config set` writes events to `config history`, and that log is how a user audits who changed what. The routes record the same events but list them in different orders: route 3 puts removals before new values, and on routes 1 and 2 the order changes from arm to arm.
context.tradeoff: Route 1 promises new values first, then removals, but its arms still differ on key order. Route 2 promises no order, and its arms differed. Route 3 lists removals first, so a reader sees what was dropped before what was set.

plan_why: Two sets that each change, add and remove several leaves. Running history afterwards shows which set/remove events each set records and in what order: sets in new document order then removes (route 1), removes before sets (route 3), or some other order such as sorted or dict order (route 2).
routes: Leaf diff of before/after; set events in new document order, then remove events in old document order
Leaf diff with one event per changed/new/removed leaf; order not pinned
Leaf diff; remove events in old document order before set events
